purpose: Public-safe GitHub storage target for PMP app-layer lossless quality and Inventory Eyes reports.
scope: App-layer inventory, route, theme, version, helper/support, privacy-surface, and lossless handoff reports.
privacy_rule: Reports stored here must contain public app structure, route/status metadata, and localStorage key names only. They must not contain private values or private Bug Memory records.
attachment_rule: This vault is attached to the app as an app-layer support store, not as part of the PMP Master and not as private memory.
next_step: Wire app/backend so Copy Lossless Report can write the newest report here safely without exposing a GitHub token in public HTML.
